label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
@ReneeK_Meyerland Renee, I am Thu, the owner of Lotus Garden. First I want to say I am really sorry your toe got hurt and you had to go to urgent care. I mean that. You have been my customer for 2 years and I don't want anybody to leave my salon and get sick. I hope it is healing good now.

I want to share what happened from our side, calm and honest, because many people are reading this.

You came in Saturday Oct 24 for the deluxe pedicure. Your tech was Vy. She is licensed 3 years, and she is my niece. During the service you asked her to cut the cuticle more, you wanted it very clean. Vy told you she should not go too much, and you told her it was fine, you always do it that way. She did what you asked. Looking back, we should have been more firm and said no. That is something we will do better. But I want people to know it was not a careless tech rushing.

About clean, because I see the comments. Every metal tool we use comes out of the autoclave in a sealed pouch, and we open it in front of the customer. Files and buffers are brand new for each person, and the customer takes them home. Every pedicure tub gets a new plastic liner every single time. The state inspected us in August 2026. We passed with no violation, and the paper is on the wall by the front desk. Anyone can come look.

You came back Nov 2 and showed me your toe. I did not mean to shrug at you. If it felt that way, I am sorry. I offered you the full $45 back, and I said I would pay your urgent care copay if you bring the receipt. You asked for $300 cash and free pedicures for one year, and I told you I could not do that. I understand you were hurting and upset. But I still believe my offer was fair. And it is still open today. The $45 and the copay are yours anytime.

You said you filed with the state. That's ok. We have nothing to hide, and I will cooperate with anything they need.

One more thing, and it is hard for me to write. You said Vy barely speak English. Vy was born here in Houston. She speaks English fine, she is just shy and quiet with people she doesn't know yet. After she read this post she cried all night, and now she tells me she wants to quit doing nails. She is a good tech and she cares about her customers. Please, if something is not right, talk to me about it. Not about her like that.

To @dave_in_gulfton, I understand you hear bad stories. But it hurt me to read that all these places are dirty, like we are all the same. I opened Lotus Garden in 2007 after working for my aunt for years. That is 19 years on Bellaire, and before this I never had one infection complaint. A lot of small salon owners work very hard to do it right. You are welcome to come see how we do it. No appointment needed just to look.

@MarisolB thank you so much. Four years you come to us, and you were kind to Renee and fair to us at the same time. That meant a lot to me and to Vy. Thank you.

Renee, I don't want to fight with you on a forum. You are my customer and I still care about you. Please call the salon, or just come in, and we can sit down and talk face to face. I will be there.

Thu
Lotus Garden Nails
